svg.title: Fano's inequality estimation setup
svg.desc: A hidden random variable X produces an observation Y, from which an estimator constructs X hat. An error indicator compares X hat with X, and Fano's inequality relates error probability to conditional entropy.
svg.text: H(Pₑ) + Pₑ log₂|𝒳| ≥ H(X | X̂) ≥ H(X | Y)
